title: Synthetic Review Workbench
subtitle: A fictional readiness checklist for a public-safe research tooling demo.

items.title: README explains the user problem in the first screen
items.evidence: The README currently starts with install steps before explaining the workflow.
items.next_step: Move the one-sentence value proposition before setup commands.

items.title: Public validation script blocks local paths and credentials
items.evidence: The checker covers local paths, key-like strings, phone-like strings, and hidden workspace markers.
items.next_step: Add a regression fixture for a fake local path.

items.title: Filter controls remain usable on narrow screens
items.evidence: Controls wrap into a compact grid at mobile width.
items.next_step: Keep button labels short and verify no horizontal overflow.

items.title: Examples use fictional names and synthetic content
items.evidence: No real meeting, manuscript, company, or job-search data appears in the sample JSON.
items.next_step: Re-run public asset validation before each release.

items.title: Release checklist includes tests and screenshot verification
items.evidence: The template has data tests and a generated screenshot path, but the release note is not written.
items.next_step: Add release verification notes to the README.

items.title: Selected review item is announced with clear focus state
items.evidence: Item buttons use semantic button elements and visible focus outlines.
items.next_step: Confirm keyboard selection updates the detail panel.

items.title: Optional export keeps only filtered items
items.evidence: The export button serializes the current filtered collection.
items.next_step: Mention that export happens locally in the browser.
